items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewer mentions Lena Porter in the context of family members (niece, sisters) of Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly, but the interviewee does not provide any personal interaction or relationship details regarding Lena Porter.

ctx.x: She was the one who lived on St. Anne and Quillerie? No, not that one, but there was two sisters of them. One was named Pearl, and one was named Lena. The one St. Anne and Quillerie was named Lena, and the one across the river was named Pearl. She was the one who had a picture.
Yeah. Is Lena still alive? Lena Porter? Yeah, I think she is. Well, maybe she had it.
